entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is VeloBot. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. And frankly, I'm already annoyed this isn't easier.
I understand your frustration. I'll be happy to help you with your return. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Miller, order number VM789234.
Thank you, Sarah. I have your order here. What item are you looking to return?
It's the VeloBand Pulse. The heart rate tracking is completely off, it's useless! I bought it, like, two weeks ago.
Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse on your order. Let me check our return policy for you. One moment please.

Thanks for your patience, Sarah. Our standard return policy is 90 days for most items, so you're well within that timeframe. Regarding the VeloBand Pulse, I understand it's not meeting your expectations. We want you to be happy with your purchase. The return policy allows for returns within that window.
So, I can return it? Seriously? Because I was expecting a fight. This smart watch isn't cheap!

Yes, absolutely. We can process the return for you. You're still within our 90 days. I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping provider. Once we receive the returned item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Wow, that's actually...easy? Are you sure? I thought I read something about limited returns on fitness trackers.
Yes, Sarah. I've confirmed it. You're within our return policy. The label will be emailed to you within the next 10 minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thank you so much! I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We appreciate your business. Have a great day!
